hook_line: JAILER 2 IS TAMIL CINEMA'S BIGGEST FILM EVER

stats.label: Worldwide gross of 2.0, the record it passed

diaspora_bullets: Overseas contributed about Rs 243.50 crore of the total
First Tamil film to cross Rs 700 crore globally
news_summary: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has reached Rs 710.35 crore worldwide in 11 days, becoming the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time and passing the record held by his own 2.0.
payoff: Jailer 2 is the first Tamil film to cross Rs 700 crore globally.
